def factor_volume_skew_smoothed_tension(df):
    """Smoothed rolling volume skew weighted by range tension to improve IC stability."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ratio = (df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]) / df_copy["close"]
    range_ratio = range_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    range_nl = np.tanh(range_ratio * 20.0)
    vol_skew = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=5).skew()
    vol_skew = vol_skew.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0)
    vol_skew_smoothed = vol_skew.ewm(span=3, min_periods=1).mean()
    factor = range_nl * vol_skew_smoothed
    df_copy["factor_volume_skew_smoothed_tension"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_volume_skew_smoothed_tension"]
